Trader consensus at 100% implied probability reflects these consistent model runs and low expected variance. eventMetadata.context_description: Moisture incursion from the Bay of Bengal and active thunderstorm activity have suppressed solar insolation over Lucknow on May 30, with India Meteorological Department forecasts calling for generally cloudy skies, intermittent rain or thundershowers, and gusty winds. This has produced official maximum temperature guidance of 33–34 °C, well below the seasonal climatological average near 40 °C and sharply lower than preceding heatwave peaks above 42 °C. Current numerical weather prediction consensus and observed surface observations reinforce this cool anomaly, driving the market’s near-certain consensus on 36 °C or below. Modest forecast uncertainty remains; any rapid clearing of cloud cover or weaker precipitation could allow brief warming toward 37–38 °C, though model runs show little support for such a shift before sunset.
